Settings

Link check

bkd can check your bookmarks in the background and show the result under each one, as if you had pressed "Check links". It visits each address about once a week, waits between requests to the same site, and leaves a site alone when it asks to.

Background checks are turned off on this server, so this setting has no effect until the administrator turns them on.
